audio.music_mood: Upbeat electronic synthesized casual puzzle music

content.concept_description: A presenter demonstrates an arrow maze puzzle shaped like a lion while an IQ score penalizes every wrong move until failure.
content.cultural_reference: Albert Einstein avatar on the IQ meter
content.why_it_works: The striking neon animal puzzle visual coupled with a punishing IQ meter challenges the viewer's ego to prove they can solve it without failing.

visuals.notable_characters: Female UGC presenter, Albert Einstein avatar on IQ meter, neon lion
visuals.notable_objects: Arrow maze puzzle, FAIL stamp, IQ progress bar

gameplay.core_gameplay_notes: Tapping arrows to slide them off the board in the correct order without hitting blocking arrows.

chapterization.chapter_description: Animated 3D neon circuit lion walks and roars.
Presenter introduces Point Out and explains arrow clearing mechanics.
Presenter taps an incorrect arrow, losing IQ points.
Presenter struggles with blocked arrows as IQ rapidly drops.
IQ falls to lowest levels and a large FAIL stamp appears.
Game logo, icon, and Play Now call-to-action button.
